description: Design forward and reverse PCR primers flanking a target region with Primer3's pair search (verified against primer3-py design_primers): per-primer limits (length, GC%, Primer3-default SantaLucia Tm, poly-X, dinucleotide repeat) plus, by default, Primer3's thermodynamic structure screen (ntthal self-dimer, 3' self-dimer, hairpin Tm <= 47 °C); pairs need a product size in product_size_range (default 100-300 bp), |ΔTm| <= max_tm_difference (default 5 °C) and pair hetero-dimer / 3' hetero-dimer Tm <= 47 °C; returns the lowest Primer3 pair penalty pair, its product Tm and complementarity, an optional internal hybridization oligo and up to num_return ranked pairs. With parameters.StructureScreen = Primer3Alignment the screen is Primer3's alignment mode (PRIMER_THERMODYNAMIC_OLIGO_ALIGNMENT=0: dpal self_any/self_end <= 8/3, pair compl_any/compl_end <= pair_max_compl_any/pair_max_compl_end 8/3) and complAny/complEnd are reported.

target_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the target region.

target_end.description: 0-based exclusive end of the target region (target_start < target_end < template.Length).

parameters.description: Optional primer-design parameters (lengths, GC%, Tm, repeats, GC-clamp/3' stability checks, structure screen and its Tm limit).

product_size_range.description: PRIMER_PRODUCT_SIZE_RANGE in Primer3 syntax, e.g. "100-300" or "150-250 100-400" (ranges in order of preference; default 100-300).

max_tm_difference.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_DIFF_TM: maximum |Tm_forward - Tm_reverse| in °C (default 5; Primer3's own default is 100).

num_return.description: PRIMER_NUM_RETURN: number of ranked pairs listed in 'pairs' (default 1).

pick_internal_oligo.description: PRIMER_PICK_INTERNAL_OLIGO: also pick an internal hybridization oligo strictly between the primers (Primer3 PRIMER_INTERNAL_* defaults).

annealing_temp.description: PRIMER_ANNEALING_TEMP: annealing temperature in °C (<= 100; default -10 = off). When > 0 each primer's (and internal oligo's) fraction bound at this temperature is computed (Primer3 oligotm, SantaLucia 1998 + SantaLucia salt correction) and reported as bound; the bound limits / weights apply.

min_bound.description: PRIMER_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound of a primer, % (only with annealing_temp > 0).

max_bound.description: PRIMER_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound of a primer, % (only with annealing_temp > 0).

opt_bound.description: PRIMER_OPT_BOUND: optimum of the bound penalty terms, % (must lie in [min_bound, max_bound]).

wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_GT: penalty weight of the fraction bound above opt_bound (only with annealing_temp > 0).

wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_LT: penalty weight of the fraction bound below opt_bound (only with annealing_temp > 0).

internal_min_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound of the internal oligo, % (only with annealing_temp > 0).

internal_max_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound of the internal oligo, % (only with annealing_temp > 0).

internal_opt_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_OPT_BOUND: optimum of the internal-oligo bound terms, %.

internal_wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_BOUND_GT: internal-oligo penalty weight of the bound above internal_opt_bound.

internal_wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_BOUND_LT: internal-oligo penalty weight of the bound below internal_opt_bound; as in Primer3 it also applies without annealing_temp (bound = -999999.9999).

inside_penalty.description: PRIMER_INSIDE_PENALTY: per-base penalty of a primer 3' end inside the target. Any combination other than the defaults (-1 / 0) lets primers overlap the target up to its far end and scores each primer's 3'-end position (positionPenalty); the default -1 then makes inside positions negative, and a negative pair penalty is an error (Primer3 aborts).

outside_penalty.description: PRIMER_OUTSIDE_PENALTY: per-base penalty of the distance between a primer 3' end and the target (see inside_penalty).

wt_pos_penalty.description: PRIMER_WT_POS_PENALTY: weight of the position penalty in the primer penalty.

sequence_quality.description: SEQUENCE_QUALITY: one integer base quality per template base (length = template length, values within [quality_range_min, quality_range_max]); primers / internal oligo report minSequenceQuality.

min_quality.description: PRIMER_MIN_QUALITY: minimum base quality of a primer (non-zero needs sequence_quality and must lie in the quality range).

min_end_quality.description: PRIMER_MIN_END_QUALITY: minimum base quality of a primer's five 3'-most bases (only with sequence_quality).

quality_range_max.description: PRIMER_QUALITY_RANGE_MAX: largest allowed sequence_quality value; the quality term is wt_seq_qual x (quality_range_max - min quality).

wt_seq_qual.description: PRIMER_WT_SEQ_QUAL: per-primer penalty weight of (quality_range_max - minimum base quality); needs sequence_quality.

wt_end_qual.description: PRIMER_WT_END_QUAL: accepted; no effect (Primer3 2.3.1 never uses it).

internal_min_quality.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MIN_QUALITY: minimum base quality of the internal oligo (non-zero needs sequence_quality).

internal_wt_seq_qual.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_SEQ_QUAL: internal-oligo penalty weight of (quality_range_max - minimum base quality); needs sequence_quality.

internal_wt_end_qual.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_END_QUAL: accepted; no effect (as in Primer3 2.3.1).

pair_wt_io_penalty.description: PRIMER_PAIR_WT_IO_PENALTY: pair penalty weight of the internal-oligo penalty; non-zero requires pick_internal_oligo (Primer3 _pr_data_control).

forward.description: Best forward primer candidate (PRIMER_LEFT_0). Includes bound (PRIMER_LEFT_0_BOUND, annealing_temp > 0) and positionPenalty (PRIMER_LEFT_0_POSITION_PENALTY, non-default inside/outside penalty).

reverse.description: Best reverse primer candidate (PRIMER_RIGHT_0). Includes bound and positionPenalty (PRIMER_RIGHT_0_*).

isValid.description: True when a compatible pair was found.

internalOligo.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_0_* (sequence, start, length, tm, gcPercent, selfAnyTh, selfEndTh, hairpinTh, penalty) when pick_internal_oligo; bound (PRIMER_INTERNAL_0_BOUND) with annealing_temp > 0.

pairs.description: Ranked valid pairs (PRIMER_PAIR_k, k < num_return), each with forward, reverse, productSize, pairPenalty, productTm, complAnyTh, complEndTh, internalOligo; empty when no pair qualifies.

errors.message: Template cannot be null or empty
Target end must be within the template
Target start must be strictly less than target end
Optimum primer / internal oligo fraction binding lower than minimum or higher than maximum; Annealing temperature higher than 100 C (Primer3 _pr_data_control)
Negative primer-pair penalty (Primer3 obj_fn PR_ASSERT(sum >= 0.0)): negative per-primer position penalties
